real_data_sources: NEMA ICS 16 — NEMA 17 standard: 42.3mm body, 31mm bolt hole pattern, M3 bolts
Stepper Motor Specification: 22mm center collar, 4x M3 threaded holes
Frame mounting: 4x M4 holes, 40mm pitch (standard 2020 extrusion)
verification_strategy: Parse FCStd ZIP Document.xml for PartDesign::Hole/Pocket (>=4 motor bolts, >=6 with frame holes), Spreadsheet::Sheet aliases (>=3 named params), STL mtime > task_start
anti_gaming_measures: Alias count verifies design is actually parametric (not just labeled)
Hole/pocket count ensures all bolt groups present
